summary: Iter 31 backend testing complete. 17/18 tests passed on first run; the 1 failure was a transient 502 on /api/health (re-run passed). All targeted areas verified: low-stock report (auth gating + buckets + soft-delete exclusion + sort), Odoo upsert new fields (promo/section/ltg/sides/prep_time), Odoo backwards-compat (minimal payload preserves new fields), admin LTG toggles for shop/restaurant/product, all new Mongo perf indexes present, and /api/shops regression (has_active_promo/has_wholesale flags).

minor.issue: One transient 502 observed during first pytest run; endpoint returns 200 on retry. Likely upstream/ingress warm-up. No code fix needed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8135 lines — long overdue for a modular split (e.g. routers per domain: orders, shops, restaurants, admin, seller, odoo). Recommend refactor before iter 35.

seller_low_stock_report reads user['settings'] but ProductionUser model may not expose that field via the JWT payload; default_threshold currently always falls back to 5. Confirm intended per-seller threshold flow.
OdooProductUpsert backwards-compat correctly only writes new fields when non-None (odoo_routes.py L197-213) — solid pattern, keep it for future field additions.
seed_data_creation: All seeded rows are prefixed TEST_iter31_<hex> and cleaned up in the module-scoped db fixture teardown. Included: 1 seller, 1 customer, 1 shop (LTG-eligible, Odoo-enabled), 1 restaurant (Odoo-enabled), 2 categories, 4 products (out-of-stock, low-stock, healthy, soft-deleted), plus one Odoo service token generated via admin API (tagged for teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Odoo webhook auth: no ODOO_WEBHOOK_TOKEN env; test generates a fresh service token via POST /api/admin/odoo/service-token/generate as admin (raw returned only once). If a token already exists in db.odoo_service_tokens on next run, the Odoo tests self-skip because the raw isn't retrievable. Alternative: call /api/admin/odoo/service-token/rotate to force-mint a new one.
